descriptions.w3d_initialize_named_panel_802ba5c4: Bind the receiver subobject at offset 28 to the original context service, create an empty native held lookup slot, and for a nonempty resource name resolve it before registering the original callback address, receiver and handle-field output. Invoke both native panel setup routines and release the local lookup interface. The resource-name address remains live across lookup as in the original. Type and role names, callback API and receiver/data/context prefixes are inferred partial external views; the callback declaration identifies its address without claiming its invocation signature. No complete class or initialized-data ownership is claimed.
